chapter: Kansas City, Omaha and Lloyd Hunter
title: Coming to Kansas City to live with his father; Sumner Junior College
summary: After finishing high school he moved to Kansas City to live with his father, attended junior college and began gigging before Jay McShann arrived.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, all right, let's not -- I'll tell you what I think we could do. Like, you joined Lloyd Hunter's band. What year do you think you joined them?
[Well, let's see.]
The latter part of '35.
So you'd been gigging with the other band.
Well, I'd been -- I was in Kansas City. You see, after I finished school, I came to Kansas City.
How come?
Well, I came there to live with my dad.
Oh, is that right?
Because that was the first time I'd seen my dad since my mother had separated.
Since you were, like, five years old.
And he found out I was in Dallas, and so he asked if I would come and stay with him awhile.
Is that right? Then you were about 19 then.
Oh, yes. I'd just finished high school. And so I said I would like to come there to go to school, so I went to junior college in Kansas City, Kansas.
Oh. Well, that's what Jay McShann, Jay MacSham, didn't he?
Yeah, Jay, he came to Kansas City, too.
Went to junior college, I think. Or
maybe that was later.
I went to Sumner Junior College there.
Oh.
And I came to Kansas City before Jay did.
Oh, did you?
Yeah, I think I did.
Well, so you had your mind a little bit on schooling then.
Oh, yes, then I came there and I started gigging around Kansas City before I even knew Jay. Jay wasn't in Kansas City at the time I came there.
